tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_get_workspace
tools.description: Get the connected workspace: its numeric id, identifier, whether it is the master workspace, and whether the key owner is an admin. Good first call to confirm the connection. PDF Generator API: GET /workspaces/{workspaceIdentifier}.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_list_templates
tools.description: List the document templates in the workspace (id, name, tags, editor type, timestamps). Use it to find a template id for pdfgeneratorapi_generate_document. PDF Generator API: GET /templates.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_get_template
tools.description: Get one template with its layout, pages and data settings. Use it to see what the template draws. PDF Generator API: GET /templates/{templateId}.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_get_template_data_fields
tools.description: List the data fields one template reads (the keys to put in the data object of pdfgeneratorapi_generate_document). Call it before you generate. PDF Generator API: GET /templates/{templateId}/data.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_list_documents
tools.description: List documents generated with output url and still stored (each has a public link, kept 30 days). Filter by template, date range or name. PDF Generator API: GET /documents.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_generate_document
tools.description: Merge a template with data and create a PDF (or HTML). Default output url stores the file on PDF Generator API for 30 days and returns its public link; this uses one generation from the plan quota. output base64 returns the whole file inline, which can be large. Set testing true to add the vendor's

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_copy_template
tools.description: Copy an existing template under a new name. The original template is not changed. Use it to make a variant before you edit the copy in the vendor's editor. PDF Generator API: POST /templates/{templateId}/copy.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_convert_html_to_pdf
tools.description: Render an HTML string to a PDF and return it inline as base64. Keep the HTML small: the base64 reply can be large. Nothing is stored on the vendor side. PDF Generator API: POST /conversion/html2pdf.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_convert_url_to_pdf
tools.description: Load a public web page in the vendor's browser and return it as a PDF, inline as base64. The URL must be reachable from the internet; private or login-only pages fail. Nothing is stored on the vendor side. PDF Generator API: POST /conversion/url2pdf.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pdfgeneratorapi_list_documents, pdfgeneratorapi_convert_url_to_pdf · Private data: pdfgeneratorapi_list_templates, pdfgeneratorapi_list_documents, pdfgeneratorapi_generate_document, pdfgeneratorapi_convert_url_to_pdf · Public sink: pdfgeneratorapi_generate_document, pdfgeneratorapi_copy_template, pdfgeneratorapi_convert_html_to_pdf, pdfgeneratorapi_convert_url_to_pdf.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pdfgeneratorapi_list_documents, pdfgeneratorapi_convert_url_to_pdf · Private data: pdfgeneratorapi_list_templates, pdfgeneratorapi_list_documents, pdfgeneratorapi_generate_document, pdfgeneratorapi_convert_url_to_pdf · Public sink: pdfgeneratorapi_generate_document, pdfgeneratorapi_copy_template, pdfgeneratorapi_convert_html_to_pdf, pdfgeneratorapi_convert_url_to_pdf

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
